items.synopsis: On MX platforms, back to back modification of the Interface profile results in ports not coming up
items.description: On MX platforms with line cards MPC11E, MX10K-LC9600 configured, the physical interface-related object remains unpublished and thus channel remains stuck in a chan_deleting state.

items.category: PFE COS features on BT based platforms
items.synopsis: The CoS core might be observed while SNMP mib walk
items.description: The CoS (Class of Service) core might be observed while SNMP (Simple Network Management Protocol) mib walk due to SNMP index handle missing in the iterator on the PTX EVO.

items.synopsis: Default DDOS rate limit for LLDP packets is 20K PPS
items.description: Default DDOS rate limit for LLDP packets is 20K PPS on PTX10003-60C , and on PTX10004/PTX10008/PTX10016 system with JNP10K-36QDD and JNP10K-4Q56DD-32Q28 line cards

items.synopsis: [PDT-SP-METRO]: EVO - ACX : Fixed classification on Ae interface doesn't work on system reboot or pfe restart
items.description: Fixed classification on Ae interface doesn't work on system reboot or pfe restart.

items.synopsis: MAC-IP bindings for IPv4 (ARP) and IPv6 (ND) may not be processed for IRB interfaces in an EVPN scenario
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, when EVPN (Ethernet Virtual Private Network) related configuration is introduced from baseline, due to a rare timing issue between the IRB (Integrated Routing and Bridging) interfaces coming up and an attempt is made by the 'l2ald' (l2 address learning) daemon to process the corresponding MAC-IP entries, this issue may occur. This may also occur when IRB logical units are activated and deactivated.

items.synopsis: network-instance name for streaming telemetry to be changed from default to DEFAULT to align with CONFIG stanza
items.description: for ONDATRA test case which tested this with different network-instance names - DEFAULT. test is failing. for TEST to pass ,use network-instance names - default.

items.synopsis: [CCL Google BX] After negative test, FIBT database out of sync with FIB database impacting FIB-streaming .
items.description: When fib streaming application is about to stream a route 'X' and that particular route 'X' gets deleted, application may run into a tight loop due to a bug in streaming code flow.

items.synopsis: The aftmand process crash might be observed
items.description: On all Junos OS Evolved platforms configured with Border Gateway Router (BGP) hierarchy in prefix-list apply-path, then changing the BGP configuration associated with apply-path will cause the firewall filter to be updated and re-program within the Packet Forwarding Engine (PFE). When filter change is processed, aftmand process crash would be observed leading to system crash.

items.synopsis: Traffic loss might be seen when multicast route changes
items.description: On Junos Evolved platforms, when a list of downstream interfaces changes for a multicast route, the rpd might perform route delete and add instead of the route change. Multicast transit traffic will be dropped during this interval.

items.category: PR related to socket replication in EVO
items.synopsis: EVO NSR: Do not send unreplicate message to backup during switchover
items.description: During swo, if unreplicate message reaches backup first before backup recovery on the connection is complete then it can lead to leaking the connection on the backup as well as recover does not happen on it. On subsequent switchover such connection may flap. The fix is highly recommended to be present in the image.

items.synopsis: JDI-RCT:EVO:PTX10004:PTX10008:PTX10016 - evo-aftmand-bt.fpc core seen
items.description: Interface-specific Firewall Filter with fast-lookup-filter CLI knob with counters configured in the Firewall config. When this filter is binded to multiple AE interfaces and then deactivated/activated(deact/act interface <> <> filter output) multiple times, evo-aftmand-bt FPC core is seen occasionally.

items.category: All Guardian (ACX7509) platform, FEB, RCB and linecaard resi
items.synopsis: Guardian HA: Backup FEB1 links down after master FEB0 restart
items.description: Links to backup FEB may go down on master FEB restart. This can become a problem on a subsequent switchover. Workaround is to do an restart of the backup FEB after master FEB has come back online (following the restart).

items.synopsis: in ACX7509, on multiple FPC restart, link is not coming up with huge FEC errors
items.description: in ACX7509, on multiple FPC restart, link is not coming up with huge FEC errors

items.synopsis: Switchover caused by master RCB power-fault may cause links to go down
items.description: Switchover caused by master RCB power-fault may cause links to go down.

items.synopsis: acx7509 :: picd/evo-pfemand core is observed occasionally when we perform restart FPCs with multi-D system scale.
items.description: If fpc is restarted with multi-D scale config, then PICD/evo-pfemand app core will be observed occasionally. However the app will be restarted and system will be restored automatically.

items.synopsis: hwdre and evo-pfemand applications may crash if idmd, fabtoken and hwdre are restarted immediately after a FEB offline.
items.description: hwdre and evo-pfemand applications may crash if idmd, fabtoken and hwdre are restarted immediately after a FEB offline.

items.category: All Guardian (ACX7509) platform, FEB, RCB and linecaard resi
items.synopsis: Rare traffic stall in scaled scenarios on FEB offline/online.
items.description: In rare case and with scaled scenarios, it is possible for PFE data path to not get properly programmed after a FEB offline/online. This can result in traffic not passing through. Workaround is to deactivate the scaled config, offline and online the FEB, and then activate the config again.

items.synopsis: On ACX7509, clockd core and interfaces going down may be observed after repeated switchover operations
items.description: On ACX7509, clockd core and interfaces going down may be observed after repeated switchover operations

items.category: Issues related to Junos licensing infrastructure
items.synopsis: PTX10008 EVO : l3vpn license warning message generated with commit check
items.description: L3VPN license warning message is generated with commit check, even though l3vpn license is installed. Commit completes without errors.

items.synopsis: Traffic loss might be seen when the new Multicast Composite Next-Hop is computed
items.description: On all Junos Evolved platforms, if a receiver joins or prunes, old Multicast composite Next-Hop (MCNH) might be deleted before all routes can shift to new MCNH. Traffic between FPC's might be dropped because few FPCs might have shifted to the new MCNH and few FPCs are waiting for the route change to the new MCNH.

items.category: Non sparks issues in jflow/monitoring services
items.synopsis: MX platforms with specific line cards are affected due to increase in HEAP memory
items.description: MX platforms with specific line cards get affected when RE based sampling is enabled which causes increase in FPC's HEAP memory usage.

items.synopsis: PTX10000s running Junos Evolved software - SNMP GET is not returning the expected value for FPC MIBs
items.description: On a platform running Junos Evolved Software, SNMP GET for FPC MIBs may intermittently return "0" instead of the real value.

items.category: Issues related to Junos Automation, Commit/Op/Event and SLAX
items.synopsis: A large configuration might not get committed at boot
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved, the mgd process might fail to commit a scaled configuration (~350K set statement) during boot due to insufficient memory.

items.category: Issues related to confg mgmt, ffp, load-action, commit procs
items.synopsis: The configuration might roll back after performing "commit confirmed" and then reboot
items.description: On all Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved platforms, the configuration might roll back after performing "commit confirmed" and then a reboot.

items.synopsis: Periodic rebalancing of subscribers over AE interface might not work
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms with scaled PPPoE (Point-to-Point Protocol over Ethernet) subscribers over static vlan-demux-interfaces over AE (Aggregated Ethernet) interface, if the child member links are flapped, periodic rebalancing of subscribers over AE interface might not happen and might lead to congestion on a particular link.

items.category: Issues related to mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL infrastructure, Juno
items.synopsis: Commit and commit check fails when the knob "interface-range" is configured
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, when the knob "interface-range" is configured commit and commit check fails.

items.category: Issues related to mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL infrastructure, Juno
items.synopsis: Config error after upgrade when modifying group for lsp auto-bandwidth /config/juniper.conf:164:(39) syntax error: adjust-interval
items.description: Config error after upgrade when modifying group for lsp auto-bandwidth /config/juniper.conf:164:(39) syntax error: adjust-interval.

items.synopsis: MTS-MCAST: [Brackla] Auto RP base verification failed with multiple RPs with same group range
items.description: We have found the workaround which is to deactivate/activate auto-rp config on brackla. This is PR is opened since 20.4 and there is no LKWR .We will be fixing it in DCB.

items.category: PRs for Avengers Interface and line card
items.synopsis: Non standard optics causing pcid core issue
items.description: Inserting third party optics not confirming to standards compliant EEPROM format can trigger the issue leading to picd cores. Removal of the cable followed by chassis restart will recover from problem state

items.synopsis: [sflow] [sflow_EVO] ACX7100-32c :: [sflow/ACX] ingress sflow for flows exiting through AE interface does not reflect the correct egress port, in the sflow frame to collector.
items.description: When the original flow is egressing out through an AE interface, the corresponding sampled sflow frame does not reflect the correct egress port number. This happens only when the flow is egressing out through an AE interface. For non-AE egress interface, this works fine and the sflow frame reflects the correct egress port.

items.synopsis: Routes in RIB and FIB table may go out of sync on all Junos Evolved platforms and causes a traffic impact
items.description: On all Junos evolved platforms, routes in RIB (Routing Information Base) and FIB (Forwarding Information Base) are not in sync when it is running over long period of the time (200+ days) with a constant route churn. It causes a traffic impact due to stale entries.

items.synopsis: Disk usage monitoring and log clean up doesn't cover zookeeper log.
items.description: Log clean-up process doesn't cover the Zookeeper log on PTX running Junos OS Evolved and it could potentially cause impact to the system when the log file size is occupying too much disk size. Manually cleaning up the log is required.

items.synopsis: agentd core - seen upon FPC ungraceful restart with cda-bt process killed
items.description: when evo-cda-bt is killed, fpc is restarted. We might see agentd crash due to ungraceful FPC restarts. This issue is not seen in a normal working scenario and is seen only upon ungraceful fpc restarts.

items.synopsis: ptx10001-36mr:22.3R1-EVO:saving a config "save re0:/var/tmp/pfe_restart.cfg" asking for password again even though logged in as super user
items.description: The system may ask for your password when you are thing to save configuration file.

items.synopsis: EVPN next hops are not correctly synchronised between RE and PFE
items.description: On all EVO platforms that support EVPN-MPLS (Ethernet Virtual Private Networks -Multiprotocol Label Switching) services, during switchover or l2-learning restart, some EVPN next hops are not correctly associated with routing-instance in RE (Routing Engine) impacting the traffic forwarding.

items.synopsis: IFLs aren't created post Graceful RE switchover on guardian platform with EVPN services
items.description: On performing Graceful RE swithchover on guardian platform with EVPN services, some IFLs are missing. IFLs come up post reboot.

items.synopsis: On ACX7509,interface flaps are observed on performing mastership switchover
items.description: On ACX7509 platforms, interface flaps are seen on performing mastership switchover using the master RE (Routing Engine) offline button press. Traffic drop will be seen due to interface flap.

items.synopsis: Guardian: The traffic drop is sometimes observed on ungraceful jack out/in of master RE.
items.description: The traffic drop greater than 50 ms is sometimes observed on an ungraceful jack out/in of master RE, however, switchover happens and traffic resumes.

items.category: Track PRs in MPLS Openconfig inside RPD.
items.synopsis: The RSVP interfaces are not streamed when removing the interface configuration
items.description: On All Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, when walking through the bandwidth-reservation leaf in RSVP-TE interface attributes sensor path, there was no check to handle the null case and close that particular streaming and move on to the next interface/sensor path when that particular interface is deleted for which the values are being streamed out. Due to this, stale entries for the Resource Reservation Protocol (RSVP) interface paths are streamed out, if the interface is deleted. This leads to OC (Open Config) Telemetry related issues.

items.synopsis: JDI-RCT : PPMD crashed at ppm_destroy_distrib_proto_stats_group_entry ( )
items.description: When l2cpd (in the context of xSTP) clears the entries that it has programmed on ppmd, ie when you delete xSTP configs from the box, there can be a possibility of ppmd core. If ppmd is in distributed mode then there will be no service impact, else there can be service impact as packet transmission for various protocols will happen via if ppmd is in centralized mode.

items.synopsis: Premature RSVP Path Error BW-Unavailable originated by PLR
items.description: With the "rsvp local reversion" configuration a PLR originates the "Bw_unavailable PathErr" during FRR (Fast Reroute). Junos Label Edge Router (LER or ingress router) ignores this type of PathErr message. However, this can be a problem if an ingress LER implementation reacts to this PathErr by bringing down the protected LSP causing packet loss.

items.synopsis: < ok/> response is getting generated along with < rpc-error>
items.description: When maximum-password-length is configured and user tries to configure password whose length exceeds configured maximum-password-length, error is thrown, along with error '' tag is also emitted. (Ideally '' tag should not be emitted in an error scenario.) The configuration does not get committed.

items.category: Issues related to YANG Data Models
items.synopsis: The command 'show system yang package | display xml' shows unexpected strings in output
items.description: The command 'show system yang package | display xml' shows unexpected strings in output.
